intro.name: Artur
intro.description: I am a full-stack software developer at Autotrac, with experience in all layers of development. I live near Brasília, Brazil. I am always open to connecting and discussing technology or new ideas.

about.title: About Me
about.content:
I have over 8 years of experience developing software, with the last 5 years focused on web development, especially in SaaS environments. I mainly work with Angular and .NET, and I enjoy moving between front-end and back-end when the project requires.
That said, front-end is where I am strongest — it's where I can combine engineering with user experience and bring ideas to life.
I am mainly looking for front-end opportunities, but I am always open to any challenge that allows me to build something useful and well crafted.

workExperience.description: Focused on front-end development using Angular, with contributions to the implementation, integration, and maintenance of Java back-end services.
Developed web applications with a primary focus on front-end development using Angular, while also contributing to the integration, maintenance, and evolution of .NET back-end services.
Developed scalable web solutions as a full-stack developer, actively contributing to the modernization and migration of legacy systems to modern technologies.
Created visual identities and graphic materials for campaigns, while improving internal processes through the development of VBA and SQL-based automation.
Developed games using Unity and C#, working across gameplay mechanics, artificial intelligence, game systems, and user interfaces.

education.description: Broad computer science education focused on full-stack web development. Coursework included programming, data structures, databases, software engineering, system architecture, and agile methodologies.

education.degree: Graduate Certificate in Systems Analysis and Development
education.description: Education focused on systems development and management, covering data structures, software engineering, project management, DevOps, and software development lifecycle fundamentals.

education.degree: Graduate Certificate in Mobile Application Development
education.description: Education focused on mobile application development, covering hybrid development frameworks and the fundamentals of native iOS and Android development.

Education in game development, covering object-oriented programming, gameplay, artificial intelligence, level design, 2D and 3D art, and audio. Recipient of the award for best game developed during the second semester of 2017.
